analysis_summary.en: The market is in extreme fear (Fear & Greed Index 12), with all coins in a daily bearish trend below SMA50. Despite negative news like Grayscale suggesting Strategy sell BTC, BTC UTXO signals indicate capitulation, possibly near a bottom. Current positions in DOGE and ETH are near breakeven or slight loss, but stop losses are not triggered. Given low volatility and neutral leverage sentiment, I choose to hold existing positions and wait for a rebound or stop loss. No new positions are opened as risk exposure is near the 50% NAV limit and clear trend or mean reversion signals are absent.
